name: VAT on construction work
review_status: The 22 percent standard rate below is taken from Federal Law No. 425-FZ of 28 November 2025, which amends article 164 of the Tax Code with effect from 1 January 2026, as stated by the Federal Tax Service on its Taxes 2026 page at https://www.nalog.gov.ru/new2026/ (read 2026-09-07). The same page lists the 10 percent reduced class among the rates that did not change. The rest of this pack is drawn from public sources and is pending review by a Russian cost engineer before it is relied on for a contract.
description: VAT sits at the very bottom of the summary estimate, applied once to everything above it including the reserve for unforeseen costs. It is the last line and never a per-item field, which matters when an estimate is imported from a jurisdiction that carries tax per line: folding the same tax into the rates and into the summary is the way a Russian bill ends up quoting a price nobody agreed to.

rates.note: The standard rate is 22 percent from 1 January 2026, raised from the 20 percent that had applied since 2019. This field carries only the rate in force now; a document dated before 2026 is charged 20 and the dated windows for that live in the platform tax seed. A contractor on a simplified tax regime does not charge it, and an estimate for such a contractor carries a compensation line for the VAT it pays on its own purchases rather than a VAT line.

currency.note: The rouble is quoted with kopecks. Rounding is applied at the totals a document publishes rather than at each line, so a line total recomputed from a rounded rate will differ from the document by small amounts that are not errors.
